transcript.en: Sandra – I seem to remember you had some family visitors staying with you recently.
transcript.zh: Sandra，我记得你家里最近来了一些亲戚做客。

transcript.en: Yeah that's right. My brother and his family were here a couple of months ago.
transcript.zh: 是的，没错。我哥哥一家几个月前来过。

transcript.en: OK good. Well I wanted to ask your advice – I've got my cousin and her family visiting next month and as I don't have kids I've no idea where to take them.
transcript.zh: 好的，我想向你请教一下建议。下个月我表姐和她家人要来玩，但因为我没有孩子，所以完全不知道该带他们去哪里玩。

transcript.en: Right. What about accommodation? Are they going to stay with you in your flat?
transcript.zh: 明白。那住宿方面呢？他们会住在你家吗？

transcript.en: No, thankfully – there wouldn't be room – my cousin wants me to recommend a hotel. Do you know anywhere?
transcript.zh: 不，还好不用，我家没那么大。我表姐让我推荐一家酒店，你知道有什么合适的吗？

transcript.en: Yes, I do actually. I always recommend people stay at the Kings Hotel.
transcript.zh: 有啊，我通常都会推荐Kings Hotel。

transcript.en: Where's that near?
transcript.zh: 在哪儿附近？

transcript.en: It's about five minutes' walk from Murray Station – so nice and central. It's actually on George Street.
transcript.zh: 离Murray车站大约步行五分钟——位置很好、靠中心，在George街。

transcript.en: Oh yes I know. I think they're on quite a tight budget – so how much roughly is it to stay there?
transcript.zh: 哦，我知道那个地方。不过他们的预算好像不太高，住一晚大概多少钱？

transcript.en: If you book a family room it's about £125 per night. My brother paid for two double rooms in the end and I think that was around £95 for each room.
transcript.zh: 如果你订家庭房的话，大概每晚125英镑左右。我哥哥最后订了两间双人房，每间大概是95英镑左右。

transcript.en: Oh that's not too bad.
transcript.zh: 哦，这个价格还不错。

transcript.en: So how old are your cousin's kids?
transcript.zh: 你表姐的孩子多大啦？

transcript.en: Twelve and nine. So I want to organise some trips while they're here.
transcript.zh: 一个十二岁，一个九岁。我想趁他们在的时候安排一些活动。

transcript.en: I was thinking of doing a bus tour of the city centre – as none of them have been here before.
transcript.zh: 我原本打算带他们坐观光巴士游览市中心，因为他们都没来过这里。

transcript.en: Those bus tours are quite expensive. I think it's better to do a walking tour – it gives you a much better feel for the city.
transcript.zh: 观光巴士挺贵的。我觉得不如自己徒步旅游，这样更能感受(我们的)城市氛围。

transcript.en: There's one that starts from Carlton Square. It takes a couple of hours and doesn't cost that much.
transcript.zh: 有一个(旅行)从Carlton广场出发，大概两个小时，费用也不高。

transcript.en: Sounds good. I'll look that up – thanks.
transcript.zh: 听起来不错，我会查一下的，谢谢。

transcript.en: If the weather's nice, one thing you could do is visit the old fort. You can get there by boat. The whole trip takes half a day.
transcript.zh: 如果天气好，你们可以去旧堡垒参观，坐船过去。整个行程大概半天。

transcript.en: That's a really good idea. I'd like to do that myself.
transcript.zh: 这主意真不错，我自己也想去看看。

transcript.en: And if the weather's bad I was thinking they could go to the Science Museum. But maybe they could do that when I'm at work.
transcript.zh: 如果天气不好，我想着，让他们去科学博物馆。不过可能那天我在上班。

transcript.en: Yeah – don't forget it's closed on Mondays.
transcript.zh: 嗯，别忘了它周一关门。

transcript.en: They're here from Saturday for four nights – so Tuesday would be best, I think.
transcript.zh: 他们是星期六来的，一共住四晚，应该选周二去最好。

transcript.en: Mmm, and it won't be so crowded then. Saturdays are terrible.
transcript.zh: 嗯，那时候也不会那么拥挤。周六人最多。

transcript.en: I took my kids to the exhibition on old computers there and it was far too crowded. I wanted to go back but it's finished now.
transcript.zh: 我之前带我孩子去看那里看“老式电脑”展，结果太挤了。我想再去一次，但展览已经结束了。

transcript.en: That's a shame. My cousin's kids would have enjoyed that.
transcript.zh: 真可惜，我表姐的孩子肯定会喜欢那个展。

transcript.en: There's another one starting soon on space which looks really good too.
transcript.zh: 很快还有一个太空主题的新展，看起来也很棒。

transcript.en: OK, well I'll mention that to my cousin.
transcript.zh: 好，我会告诉我表姐的。

transcript.en: Have you thought about where to take them to eat?
transcript.zh: 你有没有想过带他们去哪儿吃饭？

transcript.en: Well I really like all the food stalls at Clacton Market. My cousin's vegetarian – I know it's one of the best places for that kind of food.
transcript.zh: 我很喜欢Clacton市场那边的小吃摊。我表姐是素食者，我知道那儿是吃这类食物最好的地方之一。

transcript.en: Definitely, and there'll be loads of choice for the kids, too.
transcript.zh: 对的，而且孩子们也会有很多选择。

transcript.en: You need to get there quite early though – at the weekend most of the stalls stop serving lunch at 2.30.
transcript.zh: 不过你要早点去，周末很多摊位中午2:30就不卖了。

transcript.en: Good point. It's all going to need careful planning! My cousin said she'd love to take the kids to a show at the theatre – but tickets are so expensive!
transcript.zh: 好建议。看来这些事都需要好好计划！我表姐说想带孩子们去看一场剧院演出，但门票实在太贵了！

transcript.en: I know. But you can get some good deals if you book online with bargaintickets.com for the following day – on some seats there's a 75% discount.
transcript.zh: 我知道。不过如果你在网上用bargaintickets.com预订第二天的票，有些座位可以打二五折。

transcript.en: Really?! I must try and get some.
transcript.zh: 真的吗？！我一定要试试看。

transcript.en: Yeah. There are lots of things you can do for free as well – no need to spend a fortune.
transcript.zh: 其实还有很多免费的活动可以参加，不需要花太多钱。

transcript.en: Like what?
transcript.zh: 比如什么？

transcript.en: They're coming next month, right? Well, check and see if it's the same weekend as the Roots Music Festival in Blakewell Gardens.
transcript.zh: 他们不是下个月来嘛？你可以查一下是不是正好赶上Blakewell Gardens的 Roots 音乐节。

transcript.en: R double-O-T-S?
transcript.zh: R-O-O-T-S？

transcript.en: Yeah. Check it out online. It's always a family-friendly event and there's no entry charge.
transcript.zh: 对，就是这个名字。你可以上网查一下。这个音乐节一直都很适合家庭参加，而且入场免费。

transcript.en: That sounds perfect.
transcript.zh: 听起来太棒了。

transcript.en: And if you're in Blakewell Gardens – climb Telegraph Hill – you'll be able to look right down on the port.
transcript.zh: 还有，如果你去了Blakewell Gardens，记得爬Telegraph Hill，站在山顶可以看到港口的全景。

transcript.en: Everyone's always really impressed because it's so huge.
transcript.zh: 大家都觉得特别震撼，因为港口真的很大。

transcript.en: Oh yeah – I've been meaning to do that for ages. I've heard the view's amazing.
transcript.zh: 哦对，我一直想去那儿，听说风景真的很美。

transcript.en: Yeah. It's really worth the effort.
transcript.zh: 真的值得一看。

transcript.en: Well that's given me loads of ideas. Thanks so much …
transcript.zh: 你给了我好多好主意，真是太感谢了……
